تصححن (form I)
# تَصْحِحْنَ (taṣḥiḥna) /tasˤ.ħiħ.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of صَحَّ (ṣaḥḥa)
# تُصْحَحْنَ (tuṣḥaḥna) /tusˤ.ħaħ.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of صَحَّ (ṣaḥḥa)
